items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Xavier Cugat, Robert Walker, and Lena Horne on the same bill.

ctx.x: How was she to work with?

She was a princess. We played the Chez Paris in Chicago, and I got a group together to back her, and (unintelligible) was terrific. And then we began to rehearse to go into an MGM House, the Capitol Theatre in New York City, and Xavier Cugat, Robert Walker, and Lena Horne on the same bill.
